title: Red light moving through the closed church at Dionysiou

tellings.quote: I realized I saw a light in the church.

plain: A man named Ralph Larson says that in 1991, at Dionysiou, a monastery on Mount Athos in Greece, he saw a red light moving inside the church while it was closed. He tells it first-hand on the show, as something he witnessed during a stay where a monk named Timotheus also gave him books about Athos, and he offers it as a strange light in a place no one should have been.
